name: Secret Societies
overview: Scripture reveals that certain knowledge and matters are reserved for God alone, while what He has revealed is meant for His people to obey and understand, as seen in Deuteronomy 29:29. The Lord shares His covenant secrets with those who fear Him, indicating a relationship grounded in reverence and faithfulness (Psalms 25:14). However, the Bible warns against the misuse of secrets, cautioning against revealing what should remain confidential and condemning the distortion of truth by calling evil good and light darkness (Proverbs 11:13; Proverbs 25:9; Isaiah 5:20). Ultimately, secret societies that operate outside God's revelation risk embracing darkness instead of His light.
